principle_violations.reason: The Order class is managing both item details and order status, while the PaymentProcessor class handles payment processing. These represent different responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the concerns of the Order management and payment processing into distinct classes. Consider creating a separate class for managing the Order's status or a separate PaymentService that is not tied to Order directly.

principle_violations.reason: The current design requires changes to the Order class for any new operations such as adding discounts or handling different payment methods.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce interfaces or abstract classes that allow for extending functionalities without modifying existing classes. Consider creating a strategy pattern for the payment processing to handle different types of payments.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
